programs.title: Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programs.sub_title: The construction of the Soviet order 1948-1953
programs.desc: A story about the Sovietization process, from 1944 to the construction of the Berlin Wall.After World War II, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe found themselves in the Soviet zone.The events that led to such a division of the Old Continent will be presented.Viewers will learn how it affected the everyday lives of citizens of these countries and what forms of resistance they encountered.Experts will explain the mechanisms of Soviet domination.There will be witnesses' accounts, interviews, discussions of scientific works and archives including propaganda films, home recordings and feature films.

programs.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programs.desc: New information about UFOs reinforces the need for explanations.Governments are being urged to be more transparent.The need to increase the participation of independent scientists and citizens in research is also emphasized.

programs.title: Mega Building Collection
programs.desc: More impressive buildings will be presented, which attract attention with their scale and represent engineering achievements.

programs.title: Massive Engineering Mistakes 3
programs.desc: Another series of the program in which viewers learn about current and historical mishaps of engineers from around the world.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation 21
programs.desc: Reconstructions of real plane crashes.By recreating the course of events, the program's creators try to understand what led to the unfortunate events.They recreate the circumstances in which the tragedy occurred: the weather, the atmosphere on board the plane, the decisions and actions of the pilots.They also show the work of people investigating the causes of disasters and conduct a computer flight simulation.Viewers can hear various comments from specialists and testimonies of witnesses to these events.The creators of the program will prove that air accidents are often caused by human slowness and lack of imagination.Each disaster is thoroughly analyzed and the lessons learned help minimize the number of tragedies in the future.
